tagline: Your canine companion and mechanical magic.
about: Welcome to Paws & Cogs, where furry friends and mechanical marvels are welcomed with open arms! Our cafe is not just a place to relax and enjoy coffee, but also a haven for our beloved dogs and their owners. Our dog walker service offers personalized care, while our repair service ensures your gadgets and tools are always in top condition.
